visualCharacteristics.purpose: product/offer cards with eyebrow, image, heading, text and Apply/Learn More CTAs

contentPattern.structure: one row per card; one cell per part, in display order: eyebrow/heading, image, text, list, a final cell of links (first link is the primary CTA, the rest secondary). A cell holding only a /fragments/ link is replaced by the fragment

usage: Featured product offers (home page, banking pages); stats tiles on card pages; benefit tiles.
reuseGuidance: Use stats for big-number reward tiles, benefit-tiles for two wide heading + text tiles.
